absolute_deadlines.HTTP: One monotonic two-second connection deadline clamped to control and whole deadlines; recompute before every recv, header send and body send. Same routes, byte limits and at most four method/route combinations.
absolute_deadlines.IPC: Each of the four status.get/config.get exchanges has a monotonic two-second deadline. First exchange includes connect. Clamp to control and whole deadlines; recompute before connect, send and every header/body recv and check after decode. No retry or extra request.
absolute_deadlines.independent_recovery: Separate recovery thread waits on first fault/control completion or absolute 180s cutoff, cancels control, closes registered sockets and kills/reaps direct read-only command children. Product launch and native quit share a cancellation gate. Unquiesced action after1s causes terminal retained-state report and controller self-exit. No late control mutation/cache removal after cleanup.

absolute_deadlines.whole_deadline: Separate 240s timer records a fixed terminal error without taking main/ledger/evidence locks, then os._exit(1) stops every controller thread. Errors are failed/retained state, never successful cleanup. This is application scheduling/timeout logic, not a hard real-time/kernel scheduling guarantee.
